items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m playing things that I used to listen to on record, a score by Victor Young called “For Whom The Bell Tolls.”

ctx.x: Enough said. That’s good. Oh boy. What’s in the future for you, coming up?

Well next week I’m playing with Rosemary Clooney, two weeks at the Rainbow Room. And I’m doing a concert with John. I’m doing a couple of symphony dates with Skitch Henderson in Florida, in Tampa, four dates — Clearwater, St. Petersburg, Tampa. I get a big kick out of doing that too. I’m playing things that I used to listen to on record, a score by Victor Young called “For Whom The Bell Tolls.” It’s something that we all used to listen to when we were young: listen to this — and listen to this.
